fields.System.Title: RPL-102 — Validate min meaningfully below max
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want the system to reject rules that would cause constant
refilling, so that replenishment does not waste trips on two units at a time.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a max less than or equal to the min, then the rule is rejected.
  • - Given a gap smaller than one case quantity or the configured minimum gap, then the
  • rule is rejected with an explanation.
  • - Given a max exceeding the pick location's capacity, then the rule is rejected.
  • - Given a min of zero, then it is rejected — replenishment would only trigger when
  • already empty.
  • - Given existing rules that violate these checks, then they are listed by
  • [RPL-104](RPL-104-report-locations-without-rules.md) for correction.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | replenishment, masterdata |
| Tables | replen_rule, location |
| Risks | Thrashing between min and max ([doc 09 §7.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
